# 0. Chapter

    # NIGHTMARE
    # (Transformation Exorcism)

    Scanning a QR Code opens video in the browser.
    Alternatively, video stills are shown in the print 
    edition.

1   INT./EXT. VARIOUS LOCATIONS - DAY & NIGHT
    
    CAT POPE (middle-aged) has a sphynx cat head and a 
    pope's robe. Appears as PLF (Pope-like Figure), 
    CAT and CAT POPE.

    We see CAT POPE in a dream scene. Wandering as 
    a CAT, in a monastery, hunted, in the snow, in combat, in a 
    collapsing library, a graveyard. CAT POPE 
    tries to exorcise a demon from himself.

    After the failed attempt, however, CAT POPE 
    gives up and surrenders to being a CAT. Licks his 
    paws and comfortably lies down on the ground.

---
    # 1. Song

    # ROAR LITTLE KITTY      

    1st Verse   You feel like you 
                can do anything
                and you want to roar.
                How did you get lost,
                Yet, I am glad that you came,
                I give shelter and love here.
                            
    Chorus      So roar little kitty,
                Roar little kitty,
                Roar little kitty, roar.

    2nd Verse   They tell you, you are losing 
                your mind.
                They are just mocking your pride.
                Take all of your anger and fears 
                and decide!
                There are millions of eyes,
                but they are blind to my light.
                My light, my light.
                            
    Bridge      Can you feel it?
                Now you feel strong.
                Like really really really strong.
                Close your eyes,
                Take a deep breath,
                Electricity is running through 
                your body.
---
    # 1. Chapter

    # DENIAL

2   INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

                            NARRATOR (V.O.)
                A NEW DAY, AN OLD GAME!

    The music from [[Roar Little Kitty]] ended abruptly.
    PLF woke from a cruel nightmare.
    Sweating, PLF sat in bed, we saw the
    fear-filled eyes.

                            PLF
                        (shouted)
                MOM! WTF?!

    PLF pinched himself.

                            PLF (cont'd)
                Phew! It was just a dream.

    PLF fell asleep again.

3   EXT. BRUTALIST APARTMENT BLOCK - SUNRISE
    
                            NARRATOR (V.O.)
                Every morning the sun rose, it was written so. 
                It shifted, we knew it, depending on the 
                position of the Earth to  the star, and if it
                rained or there was too much fog, 
                then we could still be sure that behind it, 
                since the beginning of time, the same cosmic 
                ritual was taking place. Light followed 
                shadow, and the light was life, and with life 
                my day began.

                                            ZOOM ON APARTMENT

    {BELL RINGS}

                            NARRATOR (V.O.) (cont'd)
                To make sure this day could work, I set 
                myself  an alarm, a digital one with 
                atomic clock connection.


4   COMMERCIAL - SCHAFFHAUSEN

    Natural trust in cosmic precision and 
    traditional craftsmanship. Naturally from Schaffhausen. 
    Order your Chronomat at this promo link 
    with a 20% discount 
    https://bit.ly/catpope?code=schaffhausen 
    Because only the earliest bird catches the worm.

5   INT. BEDROOM - SUNRISE

                            NARRATOR (V.O.)
                We preaching beings had the duty to 
                appear first before the congregations and 
                perform our own rituals before them. That 
                was just part of it. It didn't bother me.

    PLF lay in bed. {RINGING}

                            NARRATOR (V.O.) (cont'd)
                Yet, I was practiced in skillfully ignoring 
                this struggle. Yes, practiced in the technique 
                of Lucid Dreaming, a method in which the 
                slumber state could be used to control one's own 
                dreams. An incredibly exciting method; it was as 
                if you were experiencing and writing a movie in 
                all reality. An indescribable feeling of power. 

                I forced the ringing into a trill. 
                It multiplied like on a DMT-trip. 

                I compressed this further until they 
                became howling sirens. 
                The sirens I took again as a sample. 
                Stabilized them. Drew with them 
                an invisible layer of Engelhorn trumpets 
                into the space and made the clouds in the 
                upper hemisphere oscillate.

    CAT appeared at the door to the bedroom. Nonchalantly 
    it jumped onto the nightstand and struck the 
    ringing device a fierce blow. It crashed to 
    the ground. PLF startled and was instantly awake.

    Silhouette of PLF in front of the window. Stared out the 
    window.

    CLOSE-UP OF THE FACE

                            PLF
                I hate Mondays... (TM Garfield)

    PLF dragged itself out of the bedroom through the 
    corridor towards the kitchen.

                            PLF (cont'd)
                First to the kitchen. Protein!

6   INT. KITCHEN

    PLF skillfully cracked two eggs simultaneously into a pan.
    
    {SIZZLE SIZZLE SIZZLE CRACK FIZZ SIZZLE SIZZLE}

    Sudden turn. There were skid marks in the air. With 
    half-closed eyes, PLF went to the toilet. Took a book. 
    Sat down.

7   INT. TOILET

    The book was titled: "The Decameron"

                            PLF
                        (thought)
                Well, a bit trivial, but good for 
                storytelling.

                            PLF
                        (continued reading)
                He made three rings and gave one to each 
                son?

                A great metaphor that there is not just one 
                true faith! Interesting, but 
                dangerous words. Luckily, no one reads 
                my thoughts. 
                            
                            NARRATOR (V.O.) 
                I thought!
                            
                            PLF
                Who determines the truth? 
                Who holds the keys to the stories? 
                Where lies the difference between my 
                will and what I stage for others? 
                Whom should I serve, if not three masters, 
                the perfect Trinity of Chaos?

    {SWOOSH SPLASH}

                            NARRATOR (V.O.)
                Naturally, the reading took longer than I 
                wanted to admit. I tended to lose myself in 
                the text. Sucked in, as if I 
                myself were the maid at the stake.

    Background noises
    
    {FRY FRY FRY SIZZLE}

                            PLF
                        (pondered)
                All fetish? All show? Do I just 
                want to entertain?

    "Let me entertain you" melody by Robbie Williams 
    played in the background.

                            PLF (cont'd)
                No, it's about more than the 
                metaphor! Ignite fires. They should 
                burn with emotions with me.

    {FRY FRY FRY SIZZLE}

                            PLF (cont'd)
                Oh, shit!

Quick exit to the kitchen

8   INT. KITCHEN

    {FIZZ FIZZ FIZZ SIZZLE}

                            PLF
                Holy Moly, Guacamole! My eggs!
                {GRRR}

    PLF took the pan and threw the burnt eggs into
    the trash can.

    {SPLAT PLOP}

                            PLF (cont'd)
                I'll eat some wafers later.
                There are more important things.
    
9   BATHROOM

    Arriving at the sink, PLF grabbed the paste –
    the blue elixir extruded out.

    {SQUEEZE, PLOP}

                            PLF (cont'd)
                Missed? WTF! It seems nothing
                is working anymore.

                            NARRATOR
                The second attempt was successful …

                            PLF
                        (angered towards the narrator)
                Thanks, but WE got it
                understood. Silence, now, I
                concentrate.

    PLF began to brush. With the back and forth of the brush. 
    {SCRUB SCRUB SCRUB SCRUB} PLF stared into the deep 
    eye rings. PLF seemed to see through itself, spat into the basin {SPLAT} and stared again 
    with a mad look in the mirror.

                            PLF (cont'd)
                        (startled)
                {ARRRRR} What was that?

                            PLF (cont'd)
                        (rubbed his eyes and yet…)
                It was there 
                    Who
                        What
                            whose, 
                            a being!
                A cat creature? In a bathrobe?

                            NARRATOR
                Nothing more! As it appeared, it was also 
                gone.

                            PLF
                Well, good, she's gone, was probably just 
                imagination.

                            CHOIR (O.S.)
                Once it means nothing.

10   INT. WARDROBE

                            NARRATOR (V.O.)
                Carefully and with practiced hand I slipped into 
                the fine gabardine, whose simple white radiated 
                its pious elegance. Gabardine, with 
                its diagonally ribbed structure, lay tightly 
                on the body. Often wrongly dismissed as common, 
                it differed significantly from 
                poplin, which was lighter and cross-ribbed. 
                However, I could not further be distracted by it. 
                I loved this 
                ritual. The tying of the laces, the folding 
                of the sleeves – everything was in place. I felt as 
               
                            PLF
                No, it was no longer a role. The 
                philosophers argued about 
                identity. 

                            NARRATOR
                Yes, spirituality/theology 
                was superior. Finally, the confidence that had been 
                so long awaited flowed through me today. I was ready.

    PLF walked out into the hallway.

    {PING}

    The elevator door opened.
    PLF descended from the penthouse in the lift. 
    {RATTLE RATTLE}

                                                ANIMATION AND 
                                                FADE OUT

    PLF stepped out of the house. Low angle shot in face, 
    the building in the background.

    From the black of the sky, the figure faded in.

                        PLF
                    (thought)
            How splendidly the light of dawn shines through 
            the corridors of the old ship!
            Exactly 54 years ago, 5 hours, 15 minutes 
            we arrived on this planet together! 
            In the year when Mao Zedong and Ulrike Meinhof 
            ascended to the Lord, we came down together. 
            To be honest, they were 
            actually at pure luck to get to heaven at all. 
            They were difficult to 
            to interpret. You have to look twice 
            you have to look at such people twice. A 
            youth without God. They themselves probably 
            wanted to become gods. They were consistent.

                        NARRATOR:IN (V.O.)
            That would be a great story, wouldn't it? 
            wouldn't it? Science fiction just fitted 
            really well with my self-image.

                        CAT
            {FAUCH}

                        PLF
            There you are again?

    On the threshold of the stairs, KATZE reappeared in the 
    corridor. She looked at PLF defiantly.
    PLF flung his long limbs awkwardly.

    {WHIP WHIP} 
                            PLF (cont'd)
                Get out of here! Pull the leash! Go you 
                beast! And  you're ugly too. OMG!

    {SWOSH} 
    
    KATZE retreated as if it had unlawfully crossed the 
    shadows of reality unlawfully, kicking 
    a cloud of dust. In that moment of defence 
    a feeling came over PLF. She was reminded of the 
    dystopian heroines from all the narratives, from 
    sci-fi to the depths of sacred texts - heroes 
    Heroes who first had to fight their inner demons 
    demons to find their true identity in a rigid world. 
    identity in a rigid world. Little did PLF know how much 
    how much this struggle would become part of her own journey 
    would become.

    PLF walked on, stepping through the meandering paths of the settlement 
    PLF 
    There you are again?
